# Shaape (https://shaape.co)

Shaape is a free web library of 500+ abstract vector shapes, cyber shapes, badge vectors, and procedural grainy noise gradients for modern UI and graphic design.
Created by Dev Chauhan (https://x.com/devchauhann3).
All shapes are 100% free for personal and commercial use without attribution.

## Main Pages
- Home & Showcase: https://shaape.co/
- Full Catalog (500+ Shapes): https://shaape.co/shapes
- Random Procedural Shape Generator: https://shaape.co/random

## Features & Export Capabilities
- Export formats: Raw SVG clipboard copy, scalable .svg file download, 4x high-resolution PNG raster download.
- Visual styles: Smooth solid normal vector, multi-color gradient, and procedural feTurbulence grainy noise texture.
- Procedural Generator: Real-time geometric topology synthesis across Stars, Flowers, and Geometry with interactive 3D physics tilt and color palette selection.
- Tech Stack: Astro, React, TypeScript, Tailwind/Clean Modern CSS tokens.
